metadata.name: amm
metadata.description: Constant-product AMM (x * y = k) on Solana with Anchor

docs: Program entrypoints for the AMM.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: @notice Deposits X/Y liquidity and mints LP tokens to the user.
@dev Locks `MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY` on the first deposit; enforces `min_lp` slippage.
@param ctx Accounts context (`Deposit`).
@param max_x Maximum token X to deposit (only the pool ratio is pulled).
@param max_y Maximum token Y to deposit (only the pool ratio is pulled).
@param min_lp Minimum acceptable LP minted (slippage protection).
@return Result<()> Ok when the deposit completes.

accounts.name: user
docs: Liquidity provider funding the deposit and paying ATA rent if needed.

accounts.name: mint_x
docs: Mint of token X (must match `config.mint_x`).

accounts.name: mint_y
docs: Mint of token Y (must match `config.mint_y`).

accounts.name: mint_lp
docs: LP mint controlled by the Config PDA.

accounts.name: config
docs: Pool config PDA. Uses stored canonical bumps (no client-supplied bump).

accounts.name: vault_x
docs: Pool vault for token X.

accounts.name: vault_y
docs: Pool vault for token Y.

accounts.name: user_x
docs: User ATA for token X.

accounts.name: user_y
docs: User ATA for token Y.

accounts.name: user_lp
docs: User ATA for LP tokens (created on first deposit if needed).

accounts.name: lock_lp
docs: Locked LP ATA owned by Config (holds `MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY` forever).

accounts.name: token_program
docs: SPL Token or Token-2022 program.

accounts.name: associated_token_program
docs: Associated Token Account program.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: System program.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: @notice Initializes a new constant-product pool.
@dev Creates Config PDA, LP mint, and vault ATAs; stores canonical bumps.
@param ctx Accounts context (`Initialize`).
@param seed PDA seed for Config.
@param fee Swap fee in basis points.
@param authority Optional admin; `None` for immutable / no admin.
@return Result<()> Ok when the pool accounts are initialized.

accounts.name: initializer
docs: Payer and transaction signer that funds account creation.

accounts.name: mint_x
docs: Mint of token X in the trading pair.

accounts.name: mint_y
docs: Mint of token Y in the trading pair.

accounts.name: config
docs: Pool configuration PDA. Space is exactly `Config::ACCOUNT_SPACE`.

accounts.name: mint_lp
docs: LP share mint. Mint authority is the Config PDA.

accounts.name: vault_x
docs: Vault holding reserves of token X. Created in the handler via ATA CPI.

accounts.name: vault_y
docs: Vault holding reserves of token Y. Created in the handler via ATA CPI.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: SPL Token or Token-2022 program (validated Interface — anti arbitrary CPI).

accounts.name: associated_token_program
docs: Associated Token Account program.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: System program for account creation.

instructions.name: set_authority
docs: @notice Transfers or renounces (`None`) the pool admin authority.
@param ctx Accounts context (`UpdateConfig`); signer must be `config.authority`.
@param new_authority Next admin, or `None` to make the pool immutable forever.
@return Result<()> Ok when the authority is stored.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Current pool admin.

accounts.name: config
docs: Pool config PDA. Uses the stored canonical bump.

instructions.name: set_locked
docs: @notice Pauses or resumes deposits and swaps (withdrawals always stay open).
@param ctx Accounts context (`UpdateConfig`); signer must be `config.authority`.
@param locked `true` to pause, `false` to resume.
@return Result<()> Ok when the flag is stored.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Current pool admin.

accounts.name: config
docs: Pool config PDA. Uses the stored canonical bump.

instructions.name: swap
docs: @notice Swaps an exact input amount for the other pool token.
@dev Fee on input; enforces constant-product invariant and `min_amount_out`.
@param ctx Accounts context (`Swap`).
@param is_x `true` for X→Y, `false` for Y→X.
@param amount_in Exact tokens sent by the user.
@param min_amount_out Minimum acceptable output (slippage).
@return Result<()> Ok when both transfers complete.

accounts.name: user
docs: Trader funding the input transfer and receiving the output.

accounts.name: mint_x
docs: Mint of token X (must match `config.mint_x`).

accounts.name: mint_y
docs: Mint of token Y (must match `config.mint_y`).

accounts.name: config
docs: Pool config PDA. Uses stored canonical bumps (no client-supplied bump).

accounts.name: vault_x
docs: Pool vault for token X.

accounts.name: vault_y
docs: Pool vault for token Y.

accounts.name: user_x
docs: User ATA for token X.

accounts.name: user_y
docs: User ATA for token Y.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: SPL Token or Token-2022 program.

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: @notice Burns LP and withdraws proportional X/Y to the user.
@dev Floor division favors the pool; cannot burn below `MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY` supply.
@param ctx Accounts context (`Withdraw`).
@param lp_amount LP tokens to burn.
@param min_x Minimum token X out (slippage).
@param min_y Minimum token Y out (slippage).
@return Result<()> Ok when burn and transfers complete.

accounts.name: user

errors.name: IdenticalVaults

errors.name: IdenticalMints

errors.name: UnsupportedMintExtension

types.name: AuthorityUpdated
docs: @notice The admin was transferred or renounced by `set_authority`.

fields.name: previous_authority
docs: Admin before the change.

fields.name: new_authority
docs: Admin after the change; `None` means renounced forever.

fields.name: config
docs: Config PDA identifying the pool.

types.name: Config
docs: On-chain configuration for a constant-product AMM pool (`x * y = k`).
Allocated with exact space `8 (discriminator) + Config::INIT_SPACE`.
Canonical bumps are persisted here so later instructions use
`bump = config.config_bump` instead of client-supplied bumps.

fields.name: authority
docs: Optional protocol / admin authority. `None` means immutable / no admin.

fields.name: mint_x
docs: Mint of token X in the pair.

fields.name: mint_y
docs: Mint of token Y in the pair.

fields.name: mint_lp
docs: LP share mint whose mint authority is the Config PDA.

fields.name: seed
docs: Client-chosen seed used in the Config PDA derivation.

fields.name: fee
docs: Swap fee in basis points (1 bps = 0.01%). Must be `<= MAX_FEE_BPS`.

fields.name: locked
docs: When `true`, deposits and swaps are rejected; withdrawals always remain open.

fields.name: config_bump
docs: Canonical bump for the Config PDA.

fields.name: lp_bump
docs: Canonical bump for the LP mint PDA.
